historical_record.description: The Bethel African Methodist Episcopal congregation took over the former Seventh Day Adventist Church here — one of the mainline Protestant churches the 1950 Sanborn maps show supplanted by African-American congregations.
Photographed, showing the Bethel A.M.E. Methodist Church.

Bethel A.M.E. bought a disused church on this site in the late 1950s and, when it proved too cramped, replaced it with a new building put up between 1969 and 1973. Identified in 2024 as eligible for local landmark, California Register or National Register designation.

historic_survey.survey: Modern & Postmodern Architectural Styles Historic Context Statement (2024)
historic_survey.note: Bethel A.M.E. Church, clad in gridded concrete and metal panels, its Late Modernism carried in the geometric interplay of sculptural forms and vertical planes. The architect is not recorded.

unknowns.rebuilt-since-photograph: The assessor dates the building to 1973, after this photograph was taken.
